verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions inside AnyDesk. The REST API and Python module for exporting session data are developer building blocks, not an in-product AI insights capability. A remote-access product with session and device data could plausibly ship such a feature, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
